title: fix(mcp): validate_expression refuses the label() call the object door refuses
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBkKie2yZBQUNvezvArGgcp)_

Fixes #28715

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the published `McpDataBridge` interface (`@objectstack/mcp`, `export type`) gains one optional member, `optionFieldsOf(name)`; a bridge that omits it behaves exactly as before. No tool input or output shape changes: `describe_object` serves the same projection, and `validate_expression`'s new verdict is an `errors[]` entry with an existing code. Expected `no` in the claim; measured `yes (widening)` because the member lands on an exported type.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：MCP 的 `validate_expression` 工具现在对 `label(record.某字段)`（字段没有声明选项，比如文本字段）给出与保存对象时相同的拒绝：同一个错误码 `label-field-no-options`、同一句话、点名字段。以前工具答 ok，保存时才被拒。
- **为什么改**：上一张卡让保存门拒绝这种公式，但 MCP 两个桥（stdio 与 HTTP）把字段投影成名称/类型/标签/必填，工具看不到选项，于是和保存门答案不一致，AI 代理白跑一轮。
- **风险与回滚**：只加一个可选的桥方法 `optionFieldsOf`，`describe_object` 的返回不变；没有这个方法的桥照旧不检查。判定仍是同一个校验器，没有新规则。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`（`validate_expression` 处理器与 `VALIDATE_SITE_MAP` 的 `optionLabels`）、`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` 与 `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`（两个桥的 `optionFieldsOf`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-validate-expression.option-labels.test.ts`，预期 13 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/mcp`**
  - `McpDataBridge` gains an optional `optionFieldsOf(name)`, answering the list of field names (or `null`): the fields of the object `describeObject` reads that declare options, or `null` when no such object is served.
  - The `validate_expression` handler, on the `formula` site, asks the bridge for that list and hands it to the one validator as `ExprSchemaHint.optionFields` (the member PR #28714 added). `label(record.FIELD)` on a declared field outside the list is then refused as `label-field-no-options`, in the sentence the door carries. No second rule and no second spelling of "declares options".
  - Only the `formula` site asks (`VALIDATE_SITE_MAP[...].optionLabels`): `@objectstack/lint`'s formula pass hands the validator `optionFields` on a formula field's `expression` and nowhere else, so `validation`, `flow_condition` and `template` answer exactly what the door answers there, as before.
  - The stdio bridge answers `optionFieldsOf` from `objectView.getObject(name)`, the read its `describeObject` makes, through `@objectstack/formula`'s `declaresOptions`.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**
  - The HTTP bridge (`buildMcpBridge`) answers `optionFieldsOf` the same way. Its by-name object read is factored into one `readServedObject(name)` that both `describeObject` and `optionFieldsOf` call, so the two cannot read different objects.
  - `vitest.config.ts` aliases `@objectstack/formula` to source, as `check:test-source-alias` prescribes for the new import.
- **`describe_object` is unchanged.** The option reading is a bridge member of its own, not a key on `describeObject`'s answer; a test pins the answer's keys (`name`, `label`, `fields`, `enableFeatures`; each field `name`, `type`, `label`, `required`).

### Which predicate, measured

The order said to pick the predicate by the document the tool reads. A one-time probe (scratch test, not committed) booted real kernels (`ObjectKernel` + `MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin` over better-sqlite3, once without and once with `environmentId: 'env_local'`) with a package declaring a picklist `tier` and an object whose `tier` field is `{ type: 'select', picklist: 'tier' }`, then read the documents each bridge reads:

<details><summary>Probe readings (field tier; first text and kind inline select as controls)</summary>

| read | shape | `tier` as read |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `protocol.getMetaItems({ type: 'object' })` (both bridges' merged read) | no `environmentId` | `{"type":"select","picklist":"tier","options":[{"label":"Gold","value":"gold"}]}` |
| `metadata.getObject(name)` (both bridges' fallback with no merged read) | no `environmentId` | same: `picklist` + resolved `options` |
| `protocol.getMetaItems({ type: 'object' })` | `env_local` | same: `picklist` + resolved `options` |
| `metadata.getObject(name)` | `env_local` | object absent (the #25120 shape; the merged read answers) |
| HTTP bridge `describeObject` (before) | both | `{"name":"tier","type":"select","label":"Tier","required":false}`: options stripped |

The stdio bridge's `objectView.getObject` reads the same `protocol.getMetaItems({ type: 'object' })` (`readMergedObjects`, `stdio-data-bridge.ts`), else `metadataService.getObject`.

</details>

Both bridges read the SERVED object, where a picklist-bound field already carries its list's options, so the served-form predicate `declaresOptions` is the one that matches; the door reads the authored body and uses `declaresOptionsOnceServed`. A `picklist`-bound select reads ok through MCP exactly as at the door (pinned below).

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-validate-expression.option-labels.test.ts` (new, 13 cases): drives the real stdio bridge (`createStdioDataBridge` over a protocol serving the measured served shape) through the shared tool handler.
  - ⭐ `label(record.first)` and `label(record.kind) + label(record.first)` answer `ok: false` with one error, `code: 'label-field-no-options'`, `params: { field: 'first' }`.
  - Controls read ok: inline `select` / `radio` options, the `picklist`-bound select, mixed expressions. `label(record.nope)` keeps exactly `['unknown-field']`. The `validation`, `flow_condition` and `template` sites answer deep-equal to the same bridge without `optionFieldsOf`. A bridge without `optionFieldsOf` answers as before. `describe_object`'s keys are unchanged.
  - PARITY: for five expressions, the same object goes through the door (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules` on the authored body, picklist-bound `tier` with no `options`) and through `validate_expression` (served body); same verdict, same error count, and each door message contains the tool's message.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-option-fields-read.test.ts` (new, 2 cases): the HTTP bridge the real `/mcp` entry builds (`HttpDispatcher.handleMcp`) answers `['kind', 'stage', 'tier']` and `null` for an absent object, from the merged listing and from the metadata service on a host with no merged read; its `describeObject` fields carry no options reading.
- Census pins updated for the new bridge member: `stdio-data-bridge.stored-metadata-body.test.ts` (`BRIDGE_MEMBERS`) and `mcp-write-response-internal-fields.tripwire.test.ts` (`RECIPES`), both "no row body / no write result".

<details><summary>Red first (base 7a48bf73 sources, new tests)</summary>

- mcp: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` and `stdio-data-bridge.ts` restored from `7a48bf73` (on-disk check: `optionFieldsOf` count 0 in both), new test file run: **4 failed | 9 passed (13)**. Red: the stdio bridge's `optionFieldsOf` case, both ⭐ LIT cases (`AssertionError: expected true to be false` on `ok`), PARITY. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- runtime: `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` restored from `7a48bf73`: **2 failed (2)**, `TypeError: bridge.optionFieldsOf is not a function`. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one line each, scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, src-resolved suite so no build leg)</summary>

- Drop `optionFields` from the hint (`...(optionFields ? { optionFields } : {})` → `...({} /* ABL_28715 */)`, marker count 1 on disk): **3 failed | 10 passed**: the two ⭐ LIT cases and PARITY (its refused rows). Every control stays green. Restore blob `999355773ff1` = HEAD blob.
- Ask on every site (`optionLabels && …` → `(/* ABL2_28715 */ true || optionLabels) && …`, marker count 1): **1 failed | 12 passed**: the site control (`validation: label(record.first) == 'x'` answers `ok: false` where the door answers ok). Restore blob = HEAD blob.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② deviation from the claim.** The claim expected `no`; I declare `yes (widening)` because `optionFieldsOf` is a new optional member on the exported `McpDataBridge` type. No wire shape changes. The order says the seat runs a contract review for a widening.
- **Sites.** The tool judges `label()` targets on the `formula` site only, because that is the only site where the door does (`judgeFieldFormula` in `@objectstack/lint`). If the door later judges validation predicates too, `VALIDATE_SITE_MAP` takes `optionLabels: true` on that row.
- **Cost.** `validate_expression` on the `formula` site now makes a second object read through the bridge (the merged listing on the HTTP bridge, the same listing `describeObject` already reads). It is an authoring tool called once per check.
- The order's per-bridge parity is pinned on the measured served shape in each package; a single real-kernel MCP round trip through both transports is left to the dogfood suite's existing MCP rigs (not added here).

## Verification

Local, on head `46c4246f`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: Test Files 49 passed (49), Tests 626 passed (626).
